messages:
alex: Morning! Quick watercooler idea: prompt-themed bake-off tomorrow at 3pm in the pantry. Bring a cookie/cake inspired by your favorite system or assistant prompt. Winner gets a sticker pack :tada: Who's in?

sam: I'm so in. I'm doing 'You are a tiny, efficient CLI' snickerdoodles. Will annotate them with `--help` tags :laughing:

maria: Count me in — 'wise grandma assistant' oatmeal raisin, with an apology note for every raisin :heart:

noah: Love this. Can we have categories? Best flavor, most accurate persona, and best inline code label? :thinking_face:

alex: yes categories and a 'badge for unexpected hallucination' (jk) :sweat_smile:

noah: @ops-bot can you spin up a simple poll and record votes? Maybe also take a pic for archive.

ops-bot: Poll created: "Prompt Bake-off — vote by reaction" — reactions open for 24h. Photo upload webhook enabled. :robot_face: https://redwood.internal/polls/1723456789

sam: Pro tip: label your cookie with the system prompt but hide the model alias. That way people guess persona not the model :detective:

maria: Ooh yes. Also printing tiny prompt cards. Anyone want to trade prompts? I'll swap my 'gentle librarian' for a 'sassy debugger' :cookie:

alex: here's my draft system line (for cookie card):
```
You are an efficient, minimal CLI assistant. Replies should be terse and use monospace.
```

noah: hahaha that's my favorite. I will attempt to make a monospace-iced sugar cookie.

sam: (reactions: alex :thumbsup:, maria :heart:, noah :laughing:)

maria: Also, if anyone needs baking utensils, ping me — I have extra tins and a spare scale.

alex: Perfect. See you all 3pm. May the best persona win :trophy:

ops-bot: Photo uploaded: prompt-bake-setup.jpg (archived) :camera:

noah: btw can we get a 'temperature' label on cookies? low/medium/high spice -> `temp: 0.2/0.7/1.2` :hot_pepper:

maria: yes and please mark gluten-free with `GF` and hallucination-risk with `⚠️` :rofl:

sam: Can't wait. Bringing napkins full of prompt puns.

alex: adjourned. watercooler energy = max. :coffee:
